doc.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021

title: Brothers, parents and weekly Zoom calls
summary: Joe says working with his brothers has been the most fun, and they now Zoom every Sunday.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: All right, that qualifies as most unusual. Well I really enjoyed our conversation today and I hope for the best for your new recording and for John’s, and I have to say that this is the first trio of brothers I’ve been able to meet with and it reminds me of Elvin, Hank and Thad. And boy, it’s quite a legacy, that I don’t know how much we can set all of this success on your father’s lap, but he did a good thing.

Both my parents did, both our parents did. And I have to say going through this music business with my brothers together as been the most fun. That’s what’s made it the most fun. We’ve been in this together from the beginning and still to this day. You know? That’s the best part of it.
Maybe I should get all three of you on a Zoom and just let you go at it telling stories.

Oh you know we have a Zoom every Sunday morning and since you’ve done your interview with Pat and I’ve watched it and John’s watched it, you know, Pat revealed things to you that he never revealed to us. So now we’re starting to get the stories rolling you know, on those Zoom calls. And it’s really — John had a lot of things to say last time that were very interesting. So I’m even, to this day I’m learning things about my own brothers that I didn’t realize.
